about: Target chains (GM - Design, #219 r24 Q2 and r47 Q1): the same cases run through backend services/agent_presence._target_chains (tests/test_agent_cursor_followups.py) and the tab's targetChains (frontend/tests/agentCursorLook.test.ts), so the two can't drift. A target is a point {x, y} or a node box {node: {x, y, width, height}}, which points at its header middle. chains lists each cursor's linked cursors, sorted.

cases.name: transitive: a-b and b-c link a and c, 30 apart
a long chain, and a gap of 16.01 splits it
the header middle: a 200x120 node at (100, 50) points at (200, 94)
a short node points half its height down
two cursors on one node always link
